paper_title: Axion Dark Matter eXperiment around 3.3 μeV with Dine-Fischler-Srednicki-Zhitnitsky Discovery Ability
notes: ADMX 2022 run haloscope search from 792-807 MHz (3.27-3.34 ueV) excluding DFSZ axions at 90% CL, assuming standard halo model (boosted Maxwell-Boltzmann) with local DM density 0.45 GeV/cm^3 (an alternative N-body model with 0.63 GeV/cm^3 was also analyzed). No numerical table provided; exclusion shown in Fig. 4. Data points are the DFSZ benchmark coupling level g_DFSZ = alpha*0.36/(pi*f_a) evaluated at the band edges, since the paper states DFSZ axions are excluded across this mass range (actual limits in most bins are somewhat below DFSZ).
